name: Admin: Logout kills server session - protected page blocked after logout
description: Log in to admin, browse pages, log out, then try to access a protected page without re-logging in. Verifies the server-side session cookie is actually destroyed.

planSteps.description: Fill in the password field with 'selam@336' and click the Sign In button (the email is hardcoded to amanuel@fufut.coffee)
Verify successful login: URL changes to contain '/app/' and the admin dashboard is displayed with sidebar navigation items (Orders, Menu, Reviews, Gallery, etc.)
Navigate to /app/orders by clicking Orders in the sidebar, wait for the page to load
Navigate to /app/menu by clicking Menu in the sidebar, wait for the page to load
Click the 'Sign Out' button in the sidebar footer
Verify the user is redirected to /login
Without logging in again, directly navigate the browser URL to /app/menu (a protected admin page)

CRITICAL: Verify the app redirects back to /login and does NOT show admin dashboard content. This proves the server session was destroyed by the logout API call, not just the client-side flag removed.
Now fill in the password field with 'selam@336' again and click Sign In to verify a fresh login works
Verify the fresh login succeeds and the admin dashboard loads with all navigation items visible
